highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Studying Chemical Engineering - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: Is Chemical Engineering taught in English in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes. Leading Finnish universities including Aalto University, LUT University, Tampere University, and the University of Oulu offer 100% English-taught master

faq.question: What is the tuition fee for Chemical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees for non-EU/EEA students range between €10,000 and €17,000 per year (approximately ₹10.5 to ₹17.85 lakh per annum). Generous merit scholarships offering 50% to 100% tuition fee waivers are available.

faq.question: Is IELTS required to study Chemical Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Yes, proof of English proficiency is generally mandatory. Accepted tests include IELTS Academic (overall 6.5 minimum), TOEFL iBT (92+), and PTE Academic (62+).

faq.question: Can international students work in Finland after graduation?
faq.answer: Yes. International graduates can apply for a 2-year post-study residence permit to seek employment or start a business in Finland and across the European Union.
